t: Sika Stixall Extreme Power Hybrid Sealant & Adhesive offers a robust solution for various construction and renovation tasks. Combines the best qualities of silicone and polyurethane, ensuring strong and flexible bonds on most common building surfaces. It is ideal for both interior and exterior applications, such as sealing joints in bathrooms or bonding materials on outdoor projects. The formula is mould-resistant, odourless, and solvent-free, providing a safer working environment. Furthermore, it can be painted over for a seamless finish and applied effectively in both wet and dry conditions.
b: Apply in Wet or Dry Conditions
